import pandas as pd

def run(inputs: dict) -> dict:
    df = inputs["readings"].copy()

    # Row-level bad rule
    is_bad = df["value"].isna() | (df["value"] < 0) | (df["value"] > 1000)
    df["_is_bad"] = is_bad

    # Batch-level aggregates
    batch_stats = df.groupby("batch_id")["_is_bad"].agg(
        bad_count="sum", total_rows="count"
    ).reset_index()

    batch_stats["quarantine"] = (batch_stats["bad_count"] * 100) > (batch_stats["total_rows"] * 20)
    batch_stats["batch_reject_pct"] = (
        batch_stats["bad_count"] * 100.0 / batch_stats["total_rows"]
    ).round(2)

    df = df.merge(
        batch_stats[["batch_id", "quarantine", "batch_reject_pct"]],
        on="batch_id",
        how="left",
    )

    quarantine_mask = df["quarantine"]

    quarantine_df = df[quarantine_mask].copy()
    non_quarantine_df = df[~quarantine_mask].copy()

    clean_df = non_quarantine_df[~non_quarantine_df["_is_bad"]].copy()
    rejects_df = non_quarantine_df[non_quarantine_df["_is_bad"]].copy()

    cols = ["batch_id", "reading_id", "sensor", "value"]

    clean_out = clean_df[cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    rejects_out = rejects_df[cols].reset_index(drop=True)
    quarantine_out = quarantine_df[cols + ["batch_reject_pct"]].reset_index(drop=True)

    return {
        "readings_clean": clean_out,
        "readings_rejects": rejects_out,
        "readings_quarantine": quarantine_out,
    }
